summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. (MOBX) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 providing a business update. The filing discloses ongoing negotiations with Vision Aerial, Inc. under a non-binding letter of intent for a potential acquisition, with no definitive agreement or terms reached yet. It also notes an expected corrective amendment to the previously disclosed Kips Bay Select LP financing transaction (not modifying material economic terms) and an anticipated resale registration statement for ~4.5 million shares. As no definitive special-situation event is consummated or binding, this is a routine business update, not a special situation.
